subject: Adding unit tests for sha256 (#2632)
reason: The change only adds unit tests: a new src/unit/test_sha256.c with three SHA-256 test vectors and their registration in src/unit/test_files.h. No server, command, replication, persistence, or tool code is modified — the SHA-256 implementation itself is untouched — so no runtime behavior changed and nothing a fuzzer scenario runs against a live server could reach or regress.
